videos.title: Slap bunt for a single
videos.description: Addi is traditionally a right-handed hitter. However, this video shows her batting from the left side and slapping a bunt for a single.

videos.title: Playing 3B, throwing a slapper out at first
videos.description: Playing 3rd base, Addi picked up this slap bunt on the run to throw a batter out running to first in the quarter-final game against Rock Gold Waye 18U.

videos.title: Homerun in PIAA Playoffs
videos.description: This homerun was hit during the 2026 PIAA playoffs against the Dallas Mountaineers.

videos.title: Prevented an infield single with a play to first
videos.description: After grabbing the ball on the second base side, a quick off balance throw prevented an infield hit.

videos.title: Homerun delivers winning run at USA Nationals
videos.description: The winning run was scored with this homerun against the Langhorne Lightning Premier at the 2025 USA Nationals East in Johnson City, TN.

videos.title: Double up the middle past a diving shortstop
videos.description: Addison hit a key double past a diving shortstop in a big win against Rock Gold Waye Mahoney 18U.

videos.title: Bunt Safely
videos.description: Against the Jersey Outlaws 18U Wells team, Addison had a successful safe bunt.

videos.title: Delayed Steal to Third Base
videos.description: In this game against the Rock Gold Theis 18U team, Addison was on 2nd base following a single and an advancement and stole 3rd base on a delayed steal.

videos.title: Another Homerun Into the Wind
videos.description: In the bottom of the 3rd inning against the Berwick Bulldogs, Addison Gaylord hit another towering homerun into the wind.

videos.title: Homerun into the Wind
videos.description: In the top of the 5th against the Nanticoke Trojanettes, Addison hit a towering homerun down the third base line into the win.

videos.title: Slapped in the Go Ahead Runs to Win
videos.description: In the top of the 6th against Holy Redeemer, Addison slapped a single to right center passed the second baseman who was playing closer to first. As a result, she picked up 2 RBIs and the go ahead runs.

videos.title: Double-Play to End the Game
videos.description: In the top of the 7th against Hanover Area, Addison turned the double-play ending the game.
